recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it narrowly completes the accepted LOINC replacement in an active Observation example without changing unrelated interpretation or quantity codings.
issue_request: FHIR-7234 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for the DSTU1 Observation creatinine example asking that Observation.code use LOINC instead of SNOMED CT 365756002 "Creatinine level".
initial_application: Commit 474be19befc8b8882da2b23a826dd0e2106a1538 removed the objected-to SNOMED CT Observation.code and method coding, but replaced Observation.code with only a local AUMC lab code and a local-only comment. That was a partial application of the Jira resolution.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps observation active in the current build. No Jira links, Zulip hits, or Confluence references were found that supersede the request. FHIR-7235 concerns the same historical example but was Resolved - No Change for interpretation flags, not Observation.code.
reconciliation: Added LOINC 14682-9 "Creatinine [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma" to source/observation/observation-example-f204-creatinine.xml and removed the stale local-only wording while retaining the local lab code as an additional coding.
source_changes: source/observation/observation-example-f204-creatinine.xml: added http://loinc.org code 14682-9 to Observation.code and updated the adjacent comment.

related_jiras.note: Same historical creatinine example, but this Resolved - No Change issue was about interpretation flags and did not affect the FHIR-7234 LOINC decision.
